# NOTHING BETTER

[Old Forester Barrel House]
[Old Forester Barrel House]
Nothing Better

While much has changed since Brown‑Forman was ***founded in 1870***, it’s what has stayed the same
that makes our story particularly remarkable. Our timeless values of integrity, respect, trust,
teamwork, and excellence live at the heart of our company and our culture. Every day we work toward
our ongoing ambition of ***Nothing Better in the Market***.

Learn More
Est. in 1870 Deep Roots. Dynamic Vision.

From barrel to bottle, our rich history and commitments have collectively crafted the foundation
upon which we work, bringing premium and super-premium spirits to the world for more than 150 years.

# We are "Créateurs de Convivialité"

Pernod Ricard is the world leader in premium international champagnes and spirits. Our iconic brands
embody our passion for brand building and human bonds.

Convivialité is the heart of everything we do, from our vineyards and farms to distilleries,
production sites, retail outlets and offices around the world. We are committed to offering products
and experiences which surprise and delight, and to ensuring a respectful and sustainable future
filled with positive human connections for all.

## Focus On

##### Jameson celebrates football culture

Jameson brings J Balvin and KidSuper together to celebrate connection within football fan culture
with a limited-edition collection drop.

 [Find out more][71]

##### Chivas Regal and Charles Leclerc unveil Chivas Regal 16 

Built on shared craft and belief in constantly challenging yourself. This is the first ever 16 year
old expression in the brand’s history and also Leclerc’s debut whisky. 

[Find out more][72]
 

## Celebrating a Timeless Spirit

Pernod Ricard’s integrated annual report 2024/2025 is now available. 
The report features custom illustrations by three graduates from the Ecole des Arts Décoratifs –
PSL. 
 

[Download the annual report][73]
[Find out more about the artists][74]

Every Pernod Ricard bottle tells a story - not just about what’s inside the bottle but of care for
our planet and communities. Discover our refreshed roadmap.

[Explore the interactive presentation][75]
 

## Magic of human connection

We create the conditions for a sustainable and responsible conviviality to flourish.

# About us

Alcools Group is Singapore’s Premiere Alcohol Business Partner in Singapore. Born out of the passion
of the nightlife industry, Alcools Group was formed through opportunity – being able to capture
Singapore’s alcohol market audience through unique partners and strategies. By curating our partners
selectively and building a client portfolio which has a strong foundation, we are able to grow a
strong and consistent demand to fuel the brands we hold in our portfolio. Our focus to introduce new
strategies and systems into Singapore’s alcohol Eco-system has proven successful. We are proud to
have achieved strong partnership’s with many globally recognized brands, as well as bridging the gap
to connect with the millennials and youth of the industry – unlocking opportunities for our partners
and providing support to multiple new-found companies in Singapore.

# Alcohol Wholesale Singapore | Liquor, Wine, Beer & Spirits Supplier

Welcome to Alcools Group, a trusted alcohol wholesale Singapore partner supplying wines, spirits,
beers, champagne, liqueurs, mixers, and beverage solutions for hospitality, retail, nightlife, and
food service businesses.

Built from deep roots in Singapore’s nightlife and beverage industry, Alcools Group supports
businesses seeking reliable alcohol supply, strong brand portfolios, and scalable beverage solutions
tailored for modern hospitality operations.

## Singapore’s Trusted Alcohol Wholesale Partner

Alcools Group specializes in wholesale alcohol supply in Singapore, supporting businesses that
require dependable sourcing across multiple beverage categories.

Our portfolio includes:
* Wine wholesale Singapore
* Beer wholesale Singapore
* Spirits wholesale Singapore
* Champagne wholesale Singapore
* Whisky wholesale Singapore
* Tequila wholesale Singapore
* Gin wholesale Singapore
* Liqueur wholesale Singapore
* Soft drinks and beverage mixers
* Hospitality beverage support solutions

Our focus is to help businesses build beverage programs with reliable inventory, recognized brands,
and scalable operational support.

## Alcohol Supplier for Hospitality, Retail & Nightlife Businesses

We work with businesses across Singapore that require professional beverage supply support and
consistent stock availability.

Commonly serving:
* Bars and cocktail lounges
* Restaurants and cafés
* Hotels and hospitality venues
* Nightclubs and entertainment businesses
* Retail and liquor stores
* Event and catering companies

Our beverage supply ecosystem is designed to support both independent venues and large-scale
commercial operations.

## Curated Global Beverage Portfolio

Alcools Group works with internationally recognized brands across multiple beverage categories,
helping businesses access products aligned with consumer demand and hospitality performance.

Our portfolio includes:
* Premium spirits
* International beers
* Fine wines
* Champagne and sparkling wines
* Cocktail liqueurs and mixers
* Soft drinks and non-alcoholic beverages

By selectively curating our beverage portfolio, we help clients build commercially practical
beverage offerings suited for modern hospitality environments.

## Built from Singapore’s Nightlife Industry

Alcools Group was born from the passion and operational realities of Singapore’s nightlife industry,
where beverage performance, brand relevance, and supply consistency are essential.

Through years of industry experience, we developed strong partnerships, scalable supply strategies,
and a growing portfolio that supports both established hospitality operators and emerging
businesses.

Our approach combines commercial beverage supply expertise with market-driven brand positioning to
create long-term opportunities for our partners.

## Why Businesses Choose Alcools Group

Businesses choose Alcools Group for dependable beverage supply and commercially practical portfolio
support.

Key advantages include:

* Curated global beverage brands
* Hospitality-focused supply support
* Scalable wholesale beverage solutions
* Reliable inventory sourcing
* Strong nightlife and horeca market understanding

Our goal is to support beverage businesses with products and supply strategies that create long-term
operational value.

## Wholesale Alcohol Supply in Singapore

For businesses seeking alcohol wholesale Singapore solutions across wines, spirits, beers,

Whether for nightlife venues, restaurants, hotels, retail businesses, or food service operations,

## Pronta per il tuo Party.

Forte ma elegante. Intensa ma morbida. Di classe, ma semplicemente perfetta per festeggiare tutta la
notte. Altamura Distilleries Vodka rappresenta un’esperienza di gusto inedita e sconosciuta, questo
è certo. Ma non solo. Altamura Distilleries Vodka è la prima vodka al mondo distillata interamente
da grano duro Altamura 100% — il cereale da cui nasce il Pane di Altamura DOP. Questa Vodka incarna
pienamente uno stato d’animo nonché un mondo fatto di persone che amano condividere e vivere al
meglio ogni momento. Tutte queste cose, questi valori e punti di vista si fondono insieme in un
tempo ed uno spazio unico, fatto di vita.

Let’s Roar

[Altamura Distilleries Premium Spirits][Altamura Distilleries Premium Spirits]
La storia di Altamura è la storia del suo pane, del suo grano e soprattutto della sua gente. Da
questo nasce il progetto Altamura Distilleries, per creare un prodotto che racchiuda tutte queste
qualità nel sorso di un distillato semplicemente unico. Siamo orgogliosi di collaborare con la
famiglia Cappiello nella figura del suo patriarca Andrea come nostro esclusivo fornitore di grano.
Questa vodka è tutta incentrata sul grano di Altamura, una qualità così speciale che il pane che ne
deriva è l'unico al mondo ad avere una designazione D.O.P. Ci auguriamo che proviate
nell'assaporarla la stessa soddisfazione e lo stesso godimento che noi proviamo nel produrla.

імпортного алкоголю на українському ринку і продовжує працювати над розширенням асортименту,

# Chopin. Vodka like no other.

Play Video

In 1993 Chopin created the world’s first super premium vodka, and the luxury vodka category was
born.

We’ve remained at the industry’s forefront ever since, driven by a guiding purpose: to show the
world that well-made, ingredient-forward vodka is worthy of being sipped and savored in the same way
as whiskey or wine.

As Poland’s last family owned vodka maker, we proudly produce small-batch, hand-crafted vodka from
our own distillery in the pristine countryside of eastern Poland.

We know the best vodka is never ‘odorless’ or ‘tasteless,’ so we invite you to try our collection of
single-ingredient vodkas and discover for yourself just how nuanced, complex and flavorful vodka can
truly be.

[ Explore the Distillery ][38]

## [The Classic Collection][39]

Potato. Rye. Wheat. The three pillars of traditional vodka, each yielding its own distinct flavor.

[ View The Collection ][40]

## [Bartender's Choice][41]

Inspired by bartenders and mixologists in search of spirit-forward cocktails. Bartender’s Choice is
a high-proof vodka with a fuller flavor profile that will take center stage in any cocktail.

[ Discover More ][42]

## [Vera Wang x Chopin][43]

A masterful collaboration, born from a shared passion for vodka, that combines style and
craftsmanship.

[ Explore the Distillery ][44]

## [Chopin Family Reserve][45]

Crafted from a rare potato variety and rested for two years, our signature vodka is one-of-a-kind.

[ Discover More ][46]

> People misunderstand vodka. They think alcohol is about drinking. No, it’s about passion. It’s

### GCG Trading | Import, export and distribution of FMCG

Which locations do you deliver?

We deliver to every part of the country. For areas outside the Nairobi metropolitan, delivery takes
12 to 24 hours. In Nairobi, we have different outlets to get closer to you, when you search for
"liquor store near me" chances are we have an outlet near you.

Some of the locations where we deliver in 30 minutes or less include;

Can I Return A Product?

Clients are allowed to return drinks in case the wrong products are delivered or there is an issue
with the delivered products. We have put these measures to ensure you can buy drinks online in
Nairobi without worrying about the quality of the drinks delivered or the delivery service.

Can I Send Wine/Whisky Gift?

You can, both corporate or personal. You can send any product on www.drinksvine.co.ke as a gift. To
send a gift send us instructions at info@drinksvine.co.ke or give us a call and we will have
delivered within the hour.

Which Types Of Wines And Spirits Do You Stock?

We offer wine, beers, spirits, soft drinks, and non-alcoholic wines. We bring the rarest drinks to
your home, we are always fully stocked with your favorite brand. We have over 3000 different
products most imported from different parts of the world. Our vast collection incorporates all the
types of alcohol in Kenya. If you have been looking for a wine shop with unique products or the best
drinks in Nairobi, give us a call. We also do gift delivery, our gift can include liquor, flower
bouquet, designer perfumes, chocolate bars among other items. We have partnered with major shops
like **Scentfied (** one of the [best designer perfume shop in Nairobi][150]) to make sure we bring
you the best gift sets.

# вино. эволюция.

Мы переосмыслили культуру виноделия.

## Лабораторные исследования

Мы выращиваем виноград без стандартных способов обработки от болезней. Болезни геолоцируются
спектральным анализом и обрабатываются локально. В переработке вина используются только органические
вещества, включая само вино. Переработка вина происходит классическим способом без добавления
«винных допингов». В процессе винификации и последующей ферментации вина образуются полезные
вещества, среди которых янтарная кислота.

[
Свойства янтарной кислоты
][10]

## Характеристики почвы

Скала, обогащенная известью с 50 см почвы, насыщена минеральными веществами, витаминами и кислотами,
полезные свойства которых переходят в состав наших вин. Высота виноградников составляет 100 метров
над уровнем моря. Плотность посадки – 4160 лоз на 1 га земли.

## Клупаж. Технология производства

Клупаж — новое слово в виноделии и во всем мире! Словослияние клубники и купажа, дало нам не только
оригинальное название, но и новый, несравненный вкус. «Семигристое» — инновационная технология
производства игристых вин и товарный знак в хуторе Семигорский муниципального образования город
Новороссийск. Производителем стал бренд «Фервино», а автором идеи создания продукта-Игорь Зубков.
Мысль заключалась в том, чтобы заменить традиционный свекольный или же тростниковый сахар в тиражном
ликёре игристых вин на натуральный клубничный. Клупаж состоит из нескольких сортов винограда. В
качестве основного компонента для создания тиражного ликера был использован клубничный сок,
полученный холодным способом. Содержание ликера минимально и составляет пять грамм, что
соответствует ста граммам свежей клубники. Её нотки дают легкое послевкусие ягоды, которое, в свою
очередь, не перебивает основные сорта винограда в клупаже. В бутылке происходит процесс ферментации,
который осуществляется классическим методом с использованием ремюажа и дегоржажа. Стабильность
клупажного «Семигристого» достигается путем естественной газации окисью углерода при выдержке в
бутылке, благодаря чему, у вас никогда не будет головной боли или состояния похмелья. Отсутствие
консервантов и классический метод производства, делают это вино уникальным и естественным продуктом!
Мы используем ручную технологию производства вина. Полный производственный цикл включает в себя 43
технологических процесса и занимает 7 лет от начала высадки и от 1,5 до 5 лет после сбора урожая.
Созревание (выдержка) вина происходит в бочках из кавказского скального дуба и длится от 9 до 18
месяцев. На этом этапе идет формирование характерного вкуса и букета.

## Терруар
## и климат

Сильные ветра, характерные для местности, создают сложный климат для выращивания винограда. Но ввиду
страдания растения корни уходят глубоко в землю, в результате низкая урожайность оказывается очень
насыщенной и минеральной, что дает вину неповторимый вкус и характерный винный камень в бутылке,
отражающий избыток минералов.

Для создания доброго имени региона и повышения качества локальных вин мы помогаем ближайшим
виноделам в проведении лабораторных анализов.

свой неповторимый характер. Для производства мы используем сорта винограда «каберне совиньон»,
«каберне фран», «мерло», «совиньон блан».

окисления янтарной кислоты позволяет отдать ей предпочтение перед другими субстратами. При любой
достаточно интенсивной физической нагрузке развивается так называемая рабочая гипоксия, когда
потребление кислорода в реакциях энергетического обмена превышает возможности его доставки к
клеткам. Практически при всех заболеваниях сердечно-сосудистой системы, легких, множестве
заболеваний крови, отравлениях, интоксикациях, применений средств химио-антибиотикотерапии,
нарушается либо доставка, либо использование кислорода, вследствие чего развивается гипоксия. При
гипоксии дыхательная цепь митохондрий не может принять на себя водород от какого - либо иного
субстрата, кроме янтарной кислоты. При окислении органических кислот отщепляется водород. Этот
водород с помощью ферментов переносится на кислород. Именно в реакции взаимодействия водорода с
кислородом освобождается энергия. В этом случае окисление янтарной кислоты в митохондриях остается
одним из немногих источников АТФ.

## Лабораторные исследования

Мы выращиваем виноград без стандартных способов обработки от болезней. Болезни геолоцируются
спектральным анализом и обрабатываются локально. В переработке вина используются только органические
вещества, включая само вино. Переработка вина происходит классическим способом без добавления
«винных допингов». В процессе винификации и последующей ферментации вина образуются полезные
вещества, среди которых янтарная кислота.

## Клупаж. Технология производства

оригинальное название, но и новый, несравненный вкус. «Семигристое» — инновационная технология
производства игристых вин и товарный знак в хуторе Семигорский муниципального образования город
Новороссийск. Производителем стал бренд «Фервино», а автором идеи создания продукта-Игорь Зубков.
Мысль заключалась в том, чтобы заменить традиционный свекольный или же тростниковый сахар в тиражном
ликёре игристых вин на натуральный клубничный. Клупаж состоит из нескольких сортов винограда. В
качестве основного компонента для создания тиражного ликера был использован клубничный сок,

Янтарь - один из самых древних драгоценных камней, известных человечеству. Во времена Римской
империи, считая янтарь окаменевшем соком сосны, он получил, название «сукцинум» (БиссиБ - сок).
Первые упоминания о лечебных свойствах янтаря и применении его в медицине принадлежат знаменитому
врачу древности Гиппократу (460-370 г.г. до н.э.) В древние времена целебные свойства янтаря
наделялись почти магической силой. В 17 веке путем перегонки янтаря была получена янтарная кислота.
Это позволило начать поисковое исследование по изучению ее свойств и влияния на организм человека,
животных и растений.

В ходе научных исследований установлено, что кислота, получившая от янтаря свое название, содержится
не только в нем. Она присуща всему живому. Вырабатывается в клетках человека, животных, растений,
отвечает за энергетический обмен. Во всех живых клетках - будь то клетки животных или растений -
содержатся особые тельца размером в несколько микрон, которые названы митохондриями. Именно в
митохондриях происходит выработка янтарной кислоты и ее использование для последующих энергетических
реакций. В митохондриях при достаточном кислородном обеспечении все органические кислоты сгорают с
образованием АТФ - универсального энергетического топлива для всех видов синтеза в клетке.

 

Какие бы питательные вещества не потреблял организм человека и животных (белки, жиры, углеводы), все
они в конечном итоге превращаются в органические кислоты цикла Кребса и затем окисляются до
углекислого газа и воды. В обычной последовательности реакций в митохондриях (в цикл Кребса)
янтарная кислота является одним из промежуточных соединений. Как показали исследования профессора
института теоретической и экспериментальной биофизики Российской Академии наук М.Н. Кондрашовой
(1971), энергетическая мощность процесса синтеза АТФ при окислении янтарной кислоты существенно
выше, чем при окислении любого другого субстрата. Но не только высокая энергетическая мощность
окисления янтарной кислоты позволяет отдать ей предпочтение перед другими субстратами. При любой
достаточно интенсивной физической нагрузке развивается так называемая рабочая гипоксия, когда
потребление кислорода в реакциях энергетического обмена превышает возможности его доставки к
клеткам. Практически при всех заболеваниях сердечно-сосудистой системы, легких, множестве
заболеваний крови, отравлениях, интоксикациях, применений средств химио-антибиотикотерапии,
нарушается либо доставка, либо использование кислорода, вследствие чего развивается гипоксия. При
гипоксии дыхательная цепь митохондрий не может принять на себя водород от какого - либо иного
субстрата, кроме янтарной кислоты. При окислении органических кислот отщепляется водород. Этот
водород с помощью ферментов переносится на кислород. Именно в реакции взаимодействия водорода с
кислородом освобождается энергия. В этом случае окисление янтарной кислоты в митохондриях остается
одним из немногих источников АТФ.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]

## It's a Lifestyle

At Good Boy Vodka, we don’t just make vodka—we create an experience. From the race track to the
beach, we’re defining what it means to live fast and drink smooth. Join us across the country as we
bring the Good Boy Vodka lifestyle to events that push the limits.

Giving Back

## Pouring for Purpose

The Good Boy Foundation is dedicated to giving back where it matters most. From supporting veterans,
to ensuring retired military working dogs receive lifelong care, to funding adoption efforts for
shelter pets—every initiative directly changes lives. With every sip of Good Boy Vodka, you’re
fueling a 100% non-profit mission that stands behind veterans, dogs, and communities nationwide.

We’re also proud to deepen our commitment by supporting women’s causes, with a special focus on
breast cancer research, awareness, and advocacy. Through our Pour For Purpose mission, we strive to
create meaningful impact for women and families across the country.

## OUR Distilleries

[ [Khortytsa Distillery]
Khortytsa Distillery
][177]

Khortytsa Distillery is the most high-tech distillery in Eastern Europe. The plant features a unique
design and is equipped with the best equipment from the world leaders of technological support of
food industry enterprises. REHAU engineering systems, GRUNDFOS pumps, TOYOTA forklifts, and highly
reliable ITAL PROJECT bottling lines ensure the accuracy of every operation, from careful dosing and
sealing to quality labeling and date marking. In 2003, the first bottle of vodka came off the
assembly line.

[Details][178]
[ [Odessa Cognac Factory]
Odessa Cognac Factory
][179]

Odessa Cognac Factory (OCF) is the oldest among the enterprises of the branch in Ukraine. The
factory’s history is connected with the Shustov dynasty and begins in 1863. Until 1956, OCF was the
only cognac producer in the country. In 2007, the legendary factory was part of the largest Eastern
European holding Global Spirits and became the industry leader. The company is fully equipped with
classic French distilleries and modern European equipment, providing a complete production cycle of
cognac, featuring a 150 years old technology. Since 2017, the factory is equipped with the largest
in Ukraine akratophor which is a special device used for sparkling wine production in a tank.

[ [Khortytsa Distillery]
Khortytsa Distillery
][177]

Khortytsa Distillery is the most high-tech distillery in Eastern Europe. The plant features a unique
design and is equipped with the best equipment from the world leaders of technological support of
food industry enterprises. REHAU engineering systems, GRUNDFOS pumps, TOYOTA forklifts, and highly
reliable ITAL PROJECT bottling lines ensure the accuracy of every operation, from careful dosing and
sealing to quality labeling and date marking. In 2003, the first bottle of vodka came off the
assembly line.

[Details][178]
[ [Odessa Cognac Factory]
Odessa Cognac Factory
][179]

Odessa Cognac Factory (OCF) is the oldest among the enterprises of the branch in Ukraine. The
factory’s history is connected with the Shustov dynasty and begins in 1863. Until 1956, OCF was the
only cognac producer in the country. In 2007, the legendary factory was part of the largest Eastern
European holding Global Spirits and became the industry leader. The company is fully equipped with
classic French distilleries and modern European equipment, providing a complete production cycle of
cognac, featuring a 150 years old technology. Since 2017, the factory is equipped with the largest
in Ukraine akratophor which is a special device used for sparkling wine production in a tank.

## Your Trusted Texan Partner in Beverage Distribution

At Hangover Street, we’re dedicated to delivering top-quality beverages, including premium wines,
authentic Mezcal, Tequila, hemp-infused drinks, and the latest in functional beverages.



We proudly serve customers across Texas, California, Florida, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, and
Illinois, ensuring reliable access to both beloved classics and innovative new products.



Our wholesale solutions cater to a diverse range of clients, including convenience stores, specialty
liquor shops, bars, restaurants, and other on-premise and off-premise establishments. Whether you’re
looking to expand your offerings or introduce exciting new brands, we provide the selection and
expertise to help your business thrive.

#### Hangover Street: Driving Beverage Success Through Sales, Merchandising, and More

At Hangover Street, we partner with trusted distributors to bring a diverse range of premium
beverages and spirits to key markets across Texas, California, Florida, Nevada, New Jersey, New
York, and Illinois. While Texas is our home turf—where we cover the entire state and serve major
cities like Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, and Houston—our reach extends far beyond.



We’re more than just a liquor distributor. Our expertise spans across wine, mezcal, tequila, and the
rapidly growing hemp and functional beverage categories.
Whether you're looking to enhance your product lineup or introduce innovative new brands, we’re here
to help your business thrive.



Our support doesn’t stop at sales and distribution. We also assist with merchandising, helping your
products stand out on the shelves, and we work alongside you to grow your brand. From finding new
retail and on-premise locations to hosting tastings and events, we’re invested in your success.



With our reliable distribution network and a focus on quality service, you can count on consistent
access to top-tier products and expert support, wherever your business operates. Trust Hangover
Street as your go-to partner for wholesale beverages—and let's work together to take your brand to
the next level.﻿

# The Northwest’s Largest and Oldest Distillery

Hood River Distillers has a rich and storied history that dates back to 1934. The company initially
produced apple and pear brandies, using excess fruit from the valley’s abundant harvests. Over the
years, Hood River Distillers expanded its product range to include a diverse array of spirits such
as vodka, gin, rum, and whiskey, inspired by the beautiful Pacific Northwest. Today, Hood River
Distillers continues to uphold its tradition of quality craftsmanship while embracing innovation.
With a portfolio that includes award-winning spirits, the distillery remains a testament to the
determination and passion of its founders, earning its place as a beloved and respected name in the
spirits industry.

Located along the Columbia River with majestic Mt. Hood as its backdrop, Hood River Distillers has
been at its current bottling facility in Hood River since 1969.

[ Learn more ][93]

## **WATCH our recent SEGMENT THAT WAS FEATURED on KOIN 6 Eye on NW Spirits**

You may see **DSP-OR-1** on some of our packaging, signage and even our local transit van! What does
this mean?
“DSP” stands for Distilled Spirits Plant, “OR” represents Oregon, and “1” acknowledges that we are
the first in the state!

# mCCARTHY’S SCORES BIG WITH WHISKY ADVOCATE

## THE RATINGS ARE IN AND McCARTHY'S 6-YEAR OLOROSO CASK FINISHED SINGLE MALT COMES OUT ON TOP!

The McCarthy's Whiskey line has truly made a mark in the world of American Single Malt Whiskeys,
with all of its expressions earning impressive scores of 92 points or higher in Whisky Advocate.
This remarkable feat reflects the brand's unwavering commitment to crafting exceptional whiskey.
Among these outstanding offerings, the McCarthy's Oloroso Cask Finished Whiskey stands out as a true
work of art, securing an extraordinary score of 95 points in the Whisky Advocate's fall issue as
well as being awarded Editor's Choice by Executive Editor David Fleming. This achievement not only
demonstrates the quality and craftsmanship behind McCarthy's but also positions the Oloroso as the
highest-ranked American Single Malt in this prestigious publication, further solidifying its place
as a standout in the world of American Whiskeys.

## Why Laurus Bio?

Laurus Bio is an integrated research-driven biomanufacturing organization with deep expertise in
precision fermentation and recombinant technology. We engineer microbes as “cell-factories” to
manufacture novel and sustainable animal-free proteins and growth factors that replace
animal-derived products in biopharma, food, health, nutrition, and personal care markets.

#### Commitment to Quality

#### Commitment to Quality

At Laurus Bio, quality is a way of life. Our advanced quality management systems and experienced
teams help us meet the highest global quality and regulatory standards. The seals of approval from
ISO, cGMP, FSSC 22000, Kosher, and Halal are a testament to our commitment to superior quality.

#### Customer-Centric Innovation

#### Customer-Centric Innovation

We are an innovation-led biotechnology company, with customer needs at the core of our R&D process.
Our vision and commitment to develop sustainable products and services motivates us to address the
needs and pain-points of industries such as Biopharma, Health, Food, Alternative and Novel Protein,
and White Biotechnology.

#### Research and Manufacturing Capabilities

#### Research and Manufacturing Capabilities

We take pride in our state-of-the-art R&D capabilities and cGMP-certified manufacturing facility.
Combining science, scale, and flexibility, we strive to exceed expectations and become the partner
of choice for our customers.

#### Location and Ecosystem

#### Location and Ecosystem

We are based in Bengaluru, the biomanufacturing hub of India that gives us access to rich talent and
a reliable supply of raw materials. Our location helps us benefit from a thriving ecosystem that
encourages advanced R&D and manufacturing in biotechnology.

## Animal-Origin-Free Solutions

Our animal-origin-free (AOF) recombinant proteins, growth factors, and cell-culture media
supplements enhance safety, lot-to-lot consistency, traceability, and competitiveness. Our
wide-ranging solutions, developed by our team of experts, cater to the needs of various industries
such as:

At Laurus Bio, we offer precision fermentation expertise as a service to our customers engaged in
microbial fermentation-based manufacturing and product development. Whether it is in clone
development, strain engineering, fermentation scale-up (from R&D/bench-scale to pilot-scale), or
large-scale commercial manufacturing — we help throughout the precision fermentation value chain, at
every step of our customers’ journey.

recipient of the MIT-OMNOVA Award for Excellence in Polymer Research.

Wheat and rye grown in EU soil and climate conditions. Triple distilled for clean taste and clarity.

Cut with pure artesian water sourced from natural springs in Latvia ensuring smooth, neutral,

#### Bankable Project Reports & Feasibility Study Services

Get professionally crafted, bankable project reports tailored to your business needs. Each report
includes detailed market analysis, techno-economic feasibility, manufacturing process, machinery
planning, investment estimates, and regulatory insights which is ideal for start-ups, entrepreneurs,
and expanding industries. Our DPRs (Detailed Project Reports) are research-driven,
implementation-ready, and suitable for bank loans, investor approvals, and business planning.

support successful project execution.

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

meeting with customers, innovating products, developing markets, and pursuing other
revenue-generating opportunities The result is a more streamlined back-office and more resources to
invest in the growth of the company.

ever-changing tastes. And, we're proud to note the results, evident in the quality products we
create across a myriad of spirits categories spanning the globe.

Iceland is full of lava rocks. We use them to filter our vodka, giving it a crisp, clean taste. You

### DISTILLED BY ICELANDERS

Reyka is distilled in Borgarnes (say Bor-gan-ess), Iceland, a coastal village surrounded by rich
natural resources. The air here is so clean, our CO2 levels are actually falling. Our master
distiller is Þórður Sigurðsson, who is also the local fireman and policeman.

### SMALL BATCHES

Reyka is distilled in small batches to ensure exceptional quality. Each distillation takes about 5
hours and makes only 330 cases. By vodka standards, that’s tiny.

### DISTILLED WITH RENEWABLE ENERGY

Our distillery is powered by geothermal energy from underground volcanoes. Not only is it
environmentally friendly, it’s fun to talk about at cocktail parties.

Iceland is full of lava rocks. We use them to filter our vodka, giving it a crisp, clean taste. You
could say it's “vodka on the rocks.” But we'd rather you didn't.

### DISTILLED BY ICELANDERS

Reyka is distilled in Borgarnes (say Bor-gan-ess), Iceland, a coastal village surrounded by rich
natural resources. The air here is so clean, our CO2 levels are actually falling. Our master
distiller is Þórður Sigurðsson, who is also the local fireman and policeman.

### SMALL BATCHES

Reyka is distilled in small batches to ensure exceptional quality. Each distillation takes about 5
hours and makes only 330 cases. By vodka standards, that’s tiny.

### DISTILLED WITH RENEWABLE ENERGY

Our distillery is powered by geothermal energy from underground volcanoes. Not only is it
environmentally friendly, it’s fun to talk about at cocktail parties.

# Custom Glass Bottle Manufacturer – Ruisen Glass

Ruisen Glass is a professional glass bottle manufacturer that integrates production and sales. As
one of China’s largest glass bottle wholesalers, Ruisen Glass has rich experience. We have advanced
production equipment to produce high-quality glass liquor bottles. We can supply a wide range of
glass bottles in various colors and sizes. In addition to standard bottles, you can also choose
custom glass bottles. You can customize any size glass bottle from 50ml to 3000ml. Besides, we can
also provide supporting products or services related to glass bottles. You can choose custom
packaging and caps. We specialize in providing you with glass bottle wholesale services.

Ruisen offers a full range of custom glass packaging solutions. We let you find the perfect glass
container. And we can provide free glass bottle samples.

## Ruisen Glass Bottle Manufacturer Strength

Yuncheng Ruisen Glass Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive enterprise that integrates glass wine bottle
development, design, production, deep processing, and sales. The company has a registered capital of
5.35 million yuan, a total investment of 300 million yuan, and currently covers an area of more than
100,000 square meters. We have 18 production lines, including fully automatic 6S, 7S, 8S, 9S, and
row machine production lines, with a daily output of more than 900,000. There are more than 600
employees in service, with mature technology and perfect production processes.

The raw materials of glass bottles are mainly flint and super flint, and different primary color
glass bottles such as green and amber. They are sent to many countries, such as Europe and America,
providing services to many international markets. We focus on high-end glass bottles and customized
services, especially ODM and OEM, covering almost all customized packaging processes for glass
bottles. The company has an intelligent automated production system and a complete business team. We
adhere to an integrity-based and quality-oriented business philosophy and strive to build a leading
enterprise that provides customers with perfect quality and the best product experience.

# We are The Absolut Company

We can’t wait to share our passion for progression and century-long tradition of fine spirit making
with you.

[About The Absolut Company][54]
[Careers][55]
[Media room][56]

## Our brands

The Absolut Company’s brands are defined by lifestyle and mindset, and a true long-term commitment
to sustainability. We are inspired by their heritage to co-create today’s popular culture.

[Absolut Vodka]

Absolut Vodka

The premier vodka from Sweden.

[Malibu]

Malibu

The all-year-round spirit of summer.

[Kahlúa]

Kahlúa

The world’s leading coffee liqueur.

### Extended portfolio

Pernod Ricard’s Crystal Brand Unit manages the Group’s clear spirits and ready-to-drink (RTD)
portfolio of premium vodka, tequila, mezcal, rum, liqueurs, gin, aperitifs and RTDs. The global
portfolio brings together a collection of vibrant, mixable, premium and ultra-premium brands. These
include Absolut Vodka, the world’s number one premium vodka; Beefeater, the world’s most awarded
gin; Malibu, the leading flavoured rum; Kahlúa, the world’s top coffee liqueur; and Lillet, the
internationally renowned aperitif. The portfolio also features agave spirits, such as the
award-winning Altos tequila and highly acclaimed craft gins like Monkey 47. We aim to shape modern
drinks culture with bold, creative brands that reflect Pernod Ricard’s commitment to excellence,
offering some of the world’s most celebrated and enduring spirits, liqueurs and aperitifs.

[The Crystal portfolio]

## Our brands

The Absolut Company’s brands are defined by lifestyle and mindset, and a true long-term commitment
to sustainability. We are inspired by their heritage to co-create today’s popular culture.

[Absolut Vodka]

Absolut Vodka

The premier vodka from Sweden.

[Malibu]

Malibu

The all-year-round spirit of summer.

[Kahlúa]

Kahlúa

The world’s leading coffee liqueur.

### Extended portfolio

Pernod Ricard’s Crystal Brand Unit manages the Group’s clear spirits and ready-to-drink (RTD)
portfolio of premium vodka, tequila, mezcal, rum, liqueurs, gin, aperitifs and RTDs. The global
portfolio brings together a collection of vibrant, mixable, premium and ultra-premium brands. These
include Absolut Vodka, the world’s number one premium vodka; Beefeater, the world’s most awarded
gin; Malibu, the leading flavoured rum; Kahlúa, the world’s top coffee liqueur; and Lillet, the
internationally renowned aperitif. The portfolio also features agave spirits, such as the
award-winning Altos tequila and highly acclaimed craft gins like Monkey 47. We aim to shape modern
drinks culture with bold, creative brands that reflect Pernod Ricard’s commitment to excellence,
offering some of the world’s most celebrated and enduring spirits, liqueurs and aperitifs.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

globally.

## WHAT WE OFFER

### Simulation

#### Simulation

At TruckersMP we take simulation seriously. Here you can immerse yourself in a virtual world
surrounded by other truckers from all over the globe driving across the USA and Europe, and with the
addition of ProMods, the world is your oyster.

### VTC System

#### VTC System

A complete VTC system is waiting for you: Join companies or create your own, and customize, recruit,
manage, post news, images and more! We will always be adding new features.

### Moderation

#### Moderation

Our moderation teams are here 365 days a year to deal with your reports. Come across a rule breaker
in game? Spammer on the forums? Never worry, our teams are here to help, no matter how long it
takes.

### Support

#### Support

Need help or assistance? Wondering what that error message means? Don't fear, our support team is
here to assist you on all platforms - social media, website, forum and Discord - and are able to
assist in multiple languages.

### Community Interaction

#### Community Interaction

Our community is actively interacting with users from across the globe. We love sharing ideas,
discussing, and having fun together in our Discord guild, Forum, Facebook, YouTube, Twitch, and much
more!

### Create your own events

#### Create your own events

Want to host events for yourself and your community? Organizing a special convoy? We have our
dedicated Event Request system to enable server support.

## VTC System

A complete and well-developed system for you to find and join a VTC that suits you best.
Alternatively, create your own company and start hiring members, organizing events, promoting, and
much more!
